title: SkyWater Technology, Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: SkyWater Technology, Inc. disclosed that both the company and IonQ, Inc. received a Second Request from the FTC on April 24, 2026, in connection with the FTC's review of their proposed merger. The Second Request extends the HSR Act waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance. The companies expect to respond promptly and continue cooperating with the FTC review. The merger remains expected to close in Q2 or Q3 2026.
